sentences.en: CAROLINE: Good Morning.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 早上好。

sentences.en: Youth Council.
sentences.zh: 青年议会。

sentences.en: Caroline speaking.
sentences.zh: 我是卡罗琳。

sentences.en: ROGER: Oh, hello, I'm interested in standing for election to the Youth Council, and was told to give you a call.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 哦，你好，我想参选青年议会，有人告诉我应该给你们打个电话。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: That's good.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 那太好了。

sentences.en: Could I have your name, please?
sentences.zh: 请问您贵姓？

sentences.en: ROGER: Yes, it's Roger Brown.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 好的，我叫罗杰·布朗。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Thank you.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm Caroline, the Youth Council administrator.
sentences.zh: 我是青年议会的行政管理员卡罗琳。

sentences.en: So do you know much about what the Council does, Roger?
sentences.zh: 那么，罗杰，你对议会的工作内容了解多少呢？

sentences.en: ROGER: I've talked to Stephanie - I think she's the chair of the Council.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 我跟斯蒂芬妮聊过——我想她就是议会主席。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: That's right.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 没错。

sentences.en: ROGER: And she told me a lot about it.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 她跟我详细介绍了相关情况。

sentences.en: How it's a way for young people to discuss local issues, for example, and make suggestions to the town council.
sentences.zh: 比如，这是年轻人讨论本地事务、并向市议会提出建议的一个平台。

sentences.en: That's what made me interested.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点让我产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Fine.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的。

sentences.en: Well let me take down some of your details.
sentences.zh: 那我来记录一下你的个人信息。

sentences.en: First of all, how old are you?
sentences.zh: 首先，你今年多大了？

sentences.en: You know the Council is for young people aged from 13 to 18?
sentences.zh: 你知道议会面向的是13至18岁的年轻人吧？

sentences.en: ROGER: I've just turned 18.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 我刚满18岁。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: And where do you live, Roger?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 罗杰，你住在哪里？

sentences.en: ROGER: Well, that's a bit complicated.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 这有点复杂。

sentences.en: At the moment I'm looking for a flat to rent here, so I'm in a hostel from Monday to Friday. go back to my parents' place at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 目前我正在这里找一套出租公寓，所以周一到周五住在一家收容所，周末则回父母家。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: OK, so where's the best place to send you some information about the Council?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的，那么寄送青年议会相关信息，寄到哪里最合适呢？

sentences.en: ROGER: Oh, to my parents' address, please.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 哦，请寄到我父母家的地址。

sentences.en: That's 17, Buckleigh Street - B-U-C-K-L-E-I- G-H Street, Stamford, Lincolnshire, though you don't really need the county.
sentences.zh: 地址是：林肯郡斯坦福市巴克利街17号——B-U-C-K-L-E-I-G-H街，不过其实不用写郡名。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Oh, I know Stamford - it's a lovely town.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 哦，我知道斯坦福——那是个美丽的小镇。

sentences.en: And what's the postcode?
sentences.zh: 邮编是多少？

sentences.en: ROGER: PE9 7QT
sentences.zh: ROGER: PE9 7QT

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Right, thank you.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: So are you working here, or are you a student?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是在这里工作，还是学生？

sentences.en: ROGER: I started studying at the university a couple of weeks ago, and I've got a part-time job for a few hours a week.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 几周前我刚进入大学学习，同时每周还做几小时的兼职工作。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: What do you do?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 你做什么工作？

sentences.en: ROGER: Well, I've done several different things.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 嗯，我做过好几种不同的工作。

sentences.en: I've just finished a short-term contract as a courier, and now I'm working as a waiter in one of the big hotels.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚结束了一份短期快递员合同，现在在一家大型酒店当服务员。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Uhuh.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 嗯。

sentences.en: That can't leave you much time for studying!
sentences.zh: 这恐怕没给你留下多少学习时间吧！

sentences.en: ROGER: Oh, it's not too bad.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 哦，其实还好。

sentences.en: I manage to fit it all it in.
sentences.zh: 我都能安排妥当。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: What are you studying?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 你正在学什么？

sentences.en: ROGER: My ambition is to go into parliament eventually, so my major subject is politics.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 我的志向是最终进入议会，因此我的主修专业是政治学。

sentences.en: That's partly why I think the Youth Council is important and want to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上也是我认为青年委员会很重要的原因，而且我也希望成为其中一员。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: And suppose you're also taking a minor subject, aren't you? know a lot of people study economics too.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 对了，你是不是还选修了一门辅修课程？我知道很多人也学经济学。

sentences.en: ROGER: chose history.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 我选的是历史。

sentences.en: To be honest.
sentences.zh: 说实话。

sentences.en: I'm not finding it as interesting as I expected!
sentences.zh: 我觉得这门课并没有我原先预期的那么有趣！

sentences.en: CAROLINE: OK, so with your studying and your part-time job, do you have time for any other interests or hobbies?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的，那么除了学习和兼职工作之外，你还有时间从事其他兴趣爱好吗？

sentences.en: ROGER: Well, I spend quite a lot of time cycling both around town to get to university and to work, and also long-distance, from here to London, for instance.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 嗯，我花了不少时间骑自行车——既在城里骑行去大学和上班地点，也进行长距离骑行，比如从这里到伦敦。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: That's pretty impressive!
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 这真令人印象深刻！

sentences.en: Anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的吗？

sentences.en: ROGER: For relaxation I'm also keen on the cinema - used to go at least once a week, but a I can't manage to go so often now.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 为了放松，我也很喜欢看电影——以前至少每周去一次，但现在没法这么频繁了。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Right.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的。

sentences.en: Are you sure you'll have enough time for the Youth Council?
sentences.zh: 你确定自己有足够的时间参与青年委员会的工作吗？

sentences.en: ROGER: Yes, I've worked out that I can afford to reduce my hours at work, and that will make the time.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 是的，我已经算过了，我可以减少兼职工作的时间，这样就能腾出所需时间。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: So is there any particular aspect of the Youth Council's work that appeals to you, Roger?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 那么，罗杰，青年委员会的哪方面工作特别吸引你呢？

sentences.en: ROGER: Well, my sister is blind, so I'm particularly interested in working with disabled young people, to try and improve the quality of their lives.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 嗯，我妹妹是盲人，因此我对与残障青年合作特别感兴趣，希望能改善他们的生活质量。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: That's great.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 这太好了。

sentences.en: Well, the best way to get involved is to be nominated by some people who you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，参与其中的最佳方式是由你认识的人提名你。

sentences.en: ROGER: Right.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 好的。

sentences.en: Can you tell me how to set about organising that?
sentences.zh: 您能告诉我该如何着手组织这件事吗？

sentences.en: CAROLINE: You should talk to Jeffrey, our Elections Officer.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 你应该去找我们的选举事务官杰弗里谈谈。

sentences.en: I can arrange a meeting in the council office with him, if you like.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，我可以安排你在委员会办公室与他见面。

sentences.en: ROGER: Yes, please.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: He'll be here next Monday, if that suits you.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 他下周一会在那里，这个时间对你合适吗？

sentences.en: ROGER: That's the 14th, isn't it?
sentences.zh: ROGER: 那是14号，对吧？

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Yes.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 没错。

sentences.en: ROGER: can manage late afternoon.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 我可以安排在下午晚些时候。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Would you like to suggest a time?
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 你想建议一个具体时间吗？

sentences.en: He generally leaves around 5.30.
sentences.zh: 他通常大约五点半离开。

sentences.en: ROGER: Well, would 4.30 be OK?
sentences.zh: ROGER: 那么四点半可以吗？

sentences.en: My last class finishes at 4, so I'd have plenty of time to get to your office.
sentences.zh: 我最后一节课四点结束，所以有充足时间赶到你们办公室。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Right, that's fine.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: Oh, and could I have a phone number we can contact you on?
sentences.zh: 哦，另外，能否提供一个我们可以联系到你的电话号码？

sentences.en: ROGER: Yes, my mobile number's 07788 136711.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 可以，我的手机号码是07788 136711。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Thank you.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Well, we'll look forward to seeing you next week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们期待下周见到你。

sentences.en: ROGER: Thanks very much.
sentences.zh: ROGER: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: CAROLINE: Bye.
sentences.zh: CAROLINE: 再见。
